newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, May up on firm cash.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, May up on firm cash.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled mixed, with May up sharply on continued firmness in the spring wheat cash market, traders said.
Deferred contracts closed lower on signals that they settled too firm and out of line Wednesday relative to other U.S. wheat markets, traders said.
"We're down on the spreads with Chicago and Kansas City. The idea is that we closed too firm yesterday compared to them," a trader said.
New crop wheat also drew pressure from continued favorable spring planting weather in the northern U.S. Plains.
MGE spring wheat ended six cents per bushel lower to six cents higher, with May up six cents at $4.26. July lost five cents to settle at $4.11-1/4.
